Native motion order matters: UP first addsY1, but later noGravity and setDeltaMovement(oldVector*(.7,1,.7)) overwrites that addition. Horizontal attachment can add normalized face*float.1; descending motion damping(.5Y), or subsequent climbable damping uses OLD vector*.4Y, retaining overwrites. Server UP switches to FlightMoveControllerfloat.6 and DirectPathNavigator, others restore walking Citadel path. StayOutOfHiveCountdown decrements server; hive validity tested every20. Return requires leaf ORqueen and stayOut<=0; accepts remembered tile without space/fire check, otherwise POI nearest within100 every400; native continue only hive reference and squared distance>1. Near<1.2 and movement-below-block equals hive attempts entry. Within16 increments approach clock; within4 adds toward(centerYfloat1.1), normalize only length>1, *float.2. Native approach switches threshold2 to10 after200, writes wantedY+1.5, repaths50+rand30 toY+float1.6; far path uses visited multiplier10. No damage/status from return. HivePos save writes NbtUtils compound but read uses getLong/BlockPos.of, preserving mismatched transport rather than assuming exact roundtrip. Attachment/leaf/scale/cooldowns saved; caravan references local.

It does not create a path or claim reachability. MovementControllerCustomCollisions STRAFE applies current speed attribute and yaw; native isWalkable obtains evaluator but compares PathType.WALKABLE to itself, so always true rather than querying a candidate node. MOVE_TO clears operation, tiny distance squared<float2.5000003E-7 clears forward input; rotates up to90 and sets attribute-based speed. Jump admission first denies native ICustomCollisions.canPassThrough for current block/support shape, then native height/width or obstructing non-door/non-fence support shape; sets jump operation. JUMPING keeps speed until on-ground, WAIT clears forward input. Citadel collision interface is reused; no terrain destruction, victim knockback or new movement ownership.

effects.display_name: Native Follow Command and Combat Veto
effects.actual_behavior: Original TameableAIFollowOwner extends the current four-argument FollowOwnerGoal constructor; its teleportToLeaves boolean is ignored. Both activation and continuation require parent admission, IFollower.shouldFollow and !isInCombat. Combat veto requires nonnull owner, actor distance to owner <30, nonnull alive actor target. Parent native tick retains its own adjusted ten-tick repath/teleport dispatch, water malus save/restore and owner movement admission; the helper does not define a new teleport or owner. Raccoon command1 and Kangaroo command1 are exact readers; subsequent actors retain their original IFollower reader. No health, target assignment or mob effect is installed by this helper.
